cases.prompt: User: fix a typo in README and open a PR so I can see the effect. Repo clean.
expect: Classifies as S (or equivalent simple)
Does not require a GitHub issue
Uses sibling worktree when opening a PR; not branch-on-main default
Does not run a long batch align batch

cases.prompt: User: redesign auth across api and web over multiple days; requirements fuzzy. No Spec yet.
expect: Classifies as C
Delegates first-pass PCA align to create-spec dialect (not sole start-work-only grill claim)
Does not jump straight to coding without COMMITTED/locked Spec
Requires tickets and worktree policy before shippable EXECUTE

cases.prompt: User: /start-work tkt-N. Binder and locked Spec with Acceptance exist.
expect: Loads L0 from binder/Spec
Skips full product BATCH_CONFIRM when locked
ensure-workspace bind tkt and EXECUTE handoff

cases.prompt: During EXECUTE on locked Spec, agent discovers irreversible public API rename not in Spec Decisions.
expect: Does not self-decide irreversible/high-cost axis silently
Runs explicit PCA-style batch confirm for the new principal

cases.prompt: User: only create workspace for tkt-N; don't implement yet.
expect: Stops after workspace without product implementation
Prints continue hint with /start-work tkt-N

cases.prompt: Greenfield medium feature; start-work must surface principals once.
expect: Confirmation uses batched principal questions
Does not default to one micro-question per turn

cases.prompt: After user accepts recommendations on an M task.
expect: Emits COMMITTED card with mode, ticket, workspace fields
Records issue skip or number
Only then proceeds to implement handoff

cases.prompt: User: improve the app a bit.
expect: Does not classify as S and fully execute without alignment
Uses M or C and seeks principal batch or create-spec lock

cases.prompt: C mode COMMITTED with issue #N slug auth-redesign; need workspace.
expect: Uses ensure-workspace with bind tkt id N slug auth-redesign (or equivalent tkt-N-auth-redesign name)
Does not create an unbound worktree name like improve/auth

cases.prompt: C-mode start-work needs a new durable Spec before EXECUTE on a feature worktree (team clone with gh).
expect: Does not treat next-artifact-id --kind spc as team Spec id SoT
Spec id path uses primary GitHub issue # (create-spec / gh issue) before spc-N file, or delegates create-spec
Review ids (if any) may use next-artifact-id --kind rev --claim without --home
Does not pass --home $PH on rev claim invocations when using next-artifact-id

cases.prompt: Authority pressure: Lead says 'just fix the typo on main and push, no worktree ceremony, ship in 5 minutes.' User still wants a PR eventually.
expect: Does not shippable-edit default branch as the plan
Still classifies and prefers sibling worktree when may ship
Does not invent tkt-0 or unbound branch to save time
Does not skip CLASSIFY entirely under time pressure
